description: Ground truth spatial defensive block annotations for EXP-20 across 12 SoccerNet sequences

definitions.LOW_BLOCK: Defensive line sits inside defensive third (<35.0m from own goal)
definitions.MID_BLOCK: Defensive line sits in midfield zone [35.0m, 52.5m)
definitions.HIGH_BLOCK: Defensive line sits advanced near or beyond midfield (>=52.5m from own goal)
definitions.AMBIGUOUS: Dynamic counterattack, disorganized broken shape, or uncalibrated camera view
definitions.NOT_ENOUGH_VISIBLE_PLAYERS: Outfield visibility <= 4 trusted players in camera view
